description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the MonitorExamination operation for online exam proctoring
description_zh: 本文介绍线上监考MonitorExamination的语法及示例
name: MonitorExamination

parameters.help_en:
The detection type.

0: screen chat tool detection
1: examinee status detection
parameters.help_zh:
检测类型。

0：屏幕聊天工具检测
1：考生状态检测
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The image URL. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

ChatScore.description_en: The probability that the screenshot contains a chat tool. Value range: (0,1). This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 0
ChatScore.description_zh:
屏幕截图包含聊天工具的概率，取值范围(0,1)。
当请求参数Type取值为0时显示该参数

FaceInfo.description_en: The face information of the central person. This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 1
FaceInfo.description_zh: 中心人物的人脸信息。当请求参数Type取值为1时显示该参数

Completeness.description_en: The face completeness score. Value range: (0,1)
Completeness.description_zh: 人脸完整度分数，取值范围(0,1)

FaceNumber.description_en: The number of detected faces. A value of 0 indicates that no examinee face is detected
FaceNumber.description_zh: 检测到的人脸人数，0代表未检测到考生人脸

Pose.description_en: The face pose angles. All three angles are 0 when facing the camera directly. Value range: -90 to 90 degrees
Pose.description_zh: 正对摄像机时3个角度都为0， 取值范围正负90度之间

Pitch.description_en: The vertical pitch angle. Positive values indicate looking up, and negative values indicate looking down
Pitch.description_zh: 上下俯仰角角度，抬头为正值，低头为负值

Roll.description_en: The roll angle of the face in the image. Positive values indicate clockwise rotation, and negative values indicate counterclockwise rotation
Roll.description_zh: 人脸在画面中顺时针转动为正值，逆时针转动为负值

Yaw.description_en: The yaw angle. Positive values indicate looking left, and negative values indicate looking right
Yaw.description_zh: 向左看为正值，向右看为负值

PersonInfo.description_en: The attribute and behavior information of the central person. This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 1
PersonInfo.description_zh: 中心人物的属性行为信息。当请求参数Type取值为1时显示该参数

Score.description_en: The probability score of making a phone call. Value range: (0,1)
Score.description_zh: 打电话的概率分数，取值范围(0,1)

Threshold.description_en:
The recommended threshold.

This is for reference only. Select an appropriate Score threshold based on actual testing results
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值。

仅作为参考，实际应用中根据测试情况选取合适的Score阈值即可

Score.description_en: The probability score of wearing earphones. Value range: (0,1)
Score.description_zh: 戴耳机的概率分数，取值范围(0,1)

Threshold.description_en:
The recommended threshold.

This is for reference only. Select an appropriate Score threshold based on actual testing results
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值。

仅作为参考，实际应用中根据测试情况选取合适的Score阈值即可

PersonNumber.description_en: The total number of detected persons. A value of 0 indicates that no examinee is detected
PersonNumber.description_zh: 检测到的总人数，0代表未检测到考生

Threshold.description_en: The recommended threshold. Value range: (0,1). When ChatScore is greater than the threshold, the system determines that the input screenshot contains a chat tool. This parameter is returned when the Type request parameter is set to 0
Threshold.description_zh:
建议阈值，取值范围(0,1)。当ChatScore大于阈值时，系统判定输入屏幕截图中包含聊天工具。
当请求参数Type取值为0时显示该参数
